notes.title: Local Multiplayer is comming soon!!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! We are excited to announce that Capoeirogue: Dandara Cordão de Ouro is now available in early access on Steam. This game is a project we’ve been working on for a while and we’re happy to share it with you. We wanted to create a game that wasn’t just a solo experience, but could also be played with friends and family. That’s why we added a local multiplayer mode so you can play with whoever you want. Additionally, we’re excited to announce that you’ll be able to play as Dandara dos Palmares or Zumbi dos Palmares. We’re working hard to make the game as accessible as possible, so stay tuned for changes in prices. We appreciate everyone who has already purchased the game and supports this journey. We hope you enjoy what’s to come!

notes.title: Early Acess is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! It is with great joy that I announce the early access of Capoeirogue. It's been a long time since I started the project until here, lots of ups and downs, all done on the low end PC, but the first steps have already been taken. I hope you like what I'm preparing for you and that you help and enthusiastically follow the development of this project of ours. Everyone is very welcome here and if you need anything, anything, you can count on me, just send me an email!
Thank you very much for your attention and I hope you have fun!

[b]Thank you very much![/b]
